$comment: Classic Mac OS System file 'PAT#' 0 (sysPatListID): 38 standard 8x8 patterns, unchanged from System 1.0 through System 7. One hex byte per row, bit 7 = leftmost pixel, 1 = black. Source: Paul Smith's DeRez of System 6 (https://github.com/paulsmith/classic-mac-patterns). QuickDraw globals: white=idx 19, black=idx 0, gray=idx 3, ltGray=idx 22, dkGray=77DD (not in PAT# 0 but HyperCard pattern 20).
